inputs.text: They’re admitting that ICE lawyers used a memo to justify arresting thousands of people leaving immigration court, even though the memo gave no authorization for those arrests. That looks less like a paperwork mistake and more like a system built to turn people’s attempts to gain legal status into a trap, with official explanations offered afterward to make it seem legitimate. The lawsuit is exposing how the institutions involved can claim to uphold the law while helping evade it.
